title: Mermaid splash: one big splash and you're underwater with a tail
summary: Pose in a leafy garden, a wall of water splashes over the lens, and you're suddenly underwater as a mermaid with a shimmering tail.
why: AI Trend Club lists a mermaid splash transformation traced to a TikTok tutorial posted November 16, 2026. It counted about 297K views and 12K likes on that post as of November 23. It's a very short clip, about 3 seconds, made from one photo. Our other reveal packs use a hand swipe or a light sweep; this one uses a splash of water.
steps: Pick a clear, full-body photo of yourself outdoors, standing in good light.
Paste the main prompt into an image-to-video tool with your photo.
Add a splash sound right on the cut, then let a calm underwater sound take over.
Post it and say it's made with AI.

prompts.label: Main prompt: garden pose, splash, mermaid
prompts.text: Use the adult in this photo. Keep their face, skin tone, hair and body exactly the same. Make a 5-second vertical clip. Seconds 0 to 2: they stand in a leafy green garden in soft daylight, strike a confident pose and smile at the camera. Second 2: a bright, clear wall of water splashes across the whole frame toward the lens. Seconds 2 to 5: the splash clears and the same person is now underwater in a calm blue sea, floating among soft sun rays and tiny bubbles. Their legs are now a long mermaid tail with shimmering teal and gold scales and a wide sheer fin. They wear a simple matching scale top. Their hair drifts slowly in the water and they give a small wave. Realistic light and water, smooth motion. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: pool-side to coral reef
prompts.text: Use the adult in this photo. Keep their face and features the same. Make a 6-second vertical clip. They sit on the edge of a backyard pool in a towel wrap, swinging their feet. They look at the camera and jump in. The splash fills the frame. When it clears, they swim slowly past a bright coral reef with small striped fish, now with a deep purple and silver mermaid tail and a matching scale top. Gentle bubbles rise from their hair. Clear tropical water, soft sun rays from above. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: winter twist
prompts.text: Use the adult in this photo. Keep their face and features the same. Make a 6-second vertical clip. They stand on a snowy lakeshore in a warm winter coat and toque, waving at the camera. A big splash of icy blue water bursts across the frame. When it clears, they float under clear frozen ice with light glowing through it, now as a mermaid with a pale silver-blue tail, a matching scale top and tiny frost sparkles in their hair. They smile and twirl once. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: swim school or pool party venue
prompts.text: Use this photo of our instructor or host [upload]. Keep their face exactly the same. Make a 6-second vertical clip. They stand on a bright indoor pool deck holding a clipboard and give a thumbs up. A big splash fills the frame. When it clears, they are underwater in the same clear blue pool, now as a friendly mermaid with a bright coral-pink tail and a matching scale top, waving the camera in. Clean, bright light. No readable text, no logos or brand names.

tips: The splash is the cut. Ask for it to cover the whole frame so the change feels like magic.
Keep it short. Five or six seconds is plenty for this one.
Only use photos of adults who said yes.
Say it's made with AI in your caption.
